title: [Bug] Omnipod not pairing properly after update
symptom: After updating from 3.2.0.1 to 3.3.1.2, the app prompted to pair with 'TWI Board' which it never did before. Every time it tries to handshake it stops abruptly and disconnects, repeating the attempt. The only temporary fix is to unpair and repair TWI Board.
cause: The issue is with new Bluetooth bonding introduced in the update.
fix: The fix is to make bonding optional, as suggested by a user and confirmed by a developer commit that makes bonding optional.
evidence_quote: Issue is with new Bluetooth bonding, I suggest making an option to use legacy or new bonding under omnipod settings
